browseKeyword.description: Optional keyword to narrow category browsing. Leave blank to browse the whole category.
browseKeyword.title: Keyword inside category

buyingFormat.description: Show only Buy It Now listings, only auctions, or both.
buyingFormat.title: Buying format

categories.description: Category IDs (for example 177) or eBay /b/ category URLs. Used in Browse mode.
categories.title: Category IDs or URLs

condition.description: Filter listings by condition. Leave on All conditions for every condition.
condition.title: Item condition

freeShipping.description: Keep only listings that advertise free shipping/delivery.
freeShipping.title: Free shipping only

includeItemSpecifics.description: Add the full item-specifics table (brand, model, MPN, dimensions, features and other aspects) to item records.
includeItemSpecifics.title: Include item specifics (Item details mode)

includeRecentFeedback.description: Add up to 25 recent feedback entries with buyer, rating, price and date to seller records.
includeRecentFeedback.title: Include recent feedback (Seller profile mode)

itemIds.description: eBay item IDs (for example 257633093777) or full /itm/ URLs. Used in Item details mode.
itemIds.title: Item IDs or URLs

itemLocation.description: Prefer items located in the marketplace country or show worldwide results.
itemLocation.title: Item location

marketplace.description: Country site used for searches and for inputs that are not already a URL.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

maxItems.description: Upper limit on item rows (or seller/store records) across all sources.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPages.description: Stop after this many result pages per search, category or store. Each page holds up to 240 listings.
maxPages.title: Max pages per source

maxPrice.description: Maximum item price in the marketplace's local currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

minPrice.description: Minimum item price in the marketplace's local currency.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

mode.description: Choose a data surface: keyword search, category browse, item details, seller feedback or a store's active listings.
enumTitles: Keyword search — listings matching your terms
Browse a category — listings inside a category
Item details — open specific item pages
Seller profile — feedback score, ratings and recent feedback
Store listings — active items from a store or seller
mode.title: What to scrape

returnsAccepted.description: Keep only listings that accept returns.
returnsAccepted.title: Returns accepted only

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on the selected marketplace. One search per entry. Use quotes for exact phrases.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sellerUsernames.description: eBay seller usernames (for example discountcomputerdepot) or /usr/ profile URLs. Used in Seller profile mode.
sellerUsernames.title: Seller usernames or profile URLs

startUrls.description: Legacy-friendly shortcut: paste search, category, item, seller or store URLs and each is routed to the right mode automatically. Ignored when the arrays above already cover that source.
startUrls.title: Paste any eBay URLs (optional shortcut)

storeNames.description: eBay store names or /str/ store URLs. Used in Store listings mode.
storeNames.title: Store names or URLs
